race.title: Exminster Golf Centre Richard Candy Memorial Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: The vote goes to ROMANY BROWN , who shaped as though ready to strike at Wetherby last time. The balance could tip toward Blue In The West if conditions become testing, with ground-versatile Locked Down Lad also considered. ROMANY BROWN (IRE) BLUE IN THE WEST (IRE) LOCKED DOWN LAD
